title: Entry point app.py, servidor y /api/salud con --check
acceptance: WHEN `python app.py --check` runs from the project root THE SYSTEM SHALL start the server on a free port of 127.0.0.1, request `/api/salud`, print one JSON line containing `"app": "gestor-expedientes"` and `"version": "0.1.0"`, shut the server down and exit 0.

WHEN `GET /api/salud` is requested THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with a JSON object whose keys are exactly `app`, `version`, `db`, `usuario` in that order, `db` being `ok` or `sin_base` and `usuario` equal to `getpass.getuser()`.
WHEN a route that does not exist is requested THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 404 with the body `{"ok": false, "error": {"codigo": "no_encontrado", "mensaje": "Ruta no encontrada: <ruta>"}}`.
WHEN the preferred port is already held by another program THE SYSTEM SHALL return the next bindable port of the range from `elegir_puerto` together with `False`.
WHEN the port being probed already answers `/api/salud` with `"app": "gestor-expedientes"` THE SYSTEM SHALL return that port together with `True` from `elegir_puerto` instead of binding it.
verify: python -W error::DeprecationWarning -m unittest tests.test_servidor -v  # expect: exit 0; el resumen final dice OK
python app.py --check | grep -q '"app": "gestor-expedientes"'  # expect: exit 0 — el entry point arranca y /api/salud responde
python -m compileall -q app.py gestor tests  # expect: exit 0, sin salida (formato/lint del proyecto)
python -W error::DeprecationWarning -m unittest discover -s tests -t .  # expect: exit 0, OK — los gates de los pasos anteriores siguen en verde
